Peanut Butter and Jelly Smoothie
By: Michelle Blackwood
Published: Monday, February 27, 2012 - 5:42am

Ingredients




1 cup almond milk or other non-dairy milk (see my almond milk recipe)
2 frozen bananas sliced
1 Tbsp peanut butter
½ cup strawberries (about 3 strawberries) or 1 Tbsp strawberry jam

Preparation

1 Place ingredients in a high speed blender like Blendtec or super smooth texture, blend on high. 2 If using a regular blender put milk and strawberries in then blend add banana pieces and peanut butter, process until smooth. 3 Garnish with crushed peanuts and serve.

About

Vegan Peanut Butter and Jelly Smoothie- Now your favorite sandwich  in a smoothie and its gluten free.
